title: Musical instruments
examples: Teacher, how does a drum make music?
Can you show me how to make a sound with my mouth?

explain.say: Today we learn how instruments make sound. Some instruments we hit to make music.
Next we learn about plucking strings. A guitar uses fingers to pluck the strings.
Some instruments need you to blow into them. A trumpet needs your breath to sound.
We can also shake things to make music. A maraca uses beads to shake and sound.
When we play music, we use many ways. We can hit, pluck, blow, or shake things.
Think about a tambourine. You can shake it, and you can also hit it too.

faq.q: What is the difference between blowing and shaking?
faq.a: Blowing uses air from your breath to make the sound. Shaking uses small things inside to make a rattling sound.
asks: How do I use my breath for music?

faq.q: Can I hit anything to make music?
faq.a: Yes, you can hit things like pots or drums. You need something solid to hit.

faq.q: Do all string instruments use plucking?
faq.a: No, some string instruments might be bowed, like a violin. But plucking is one way to make sound.
asks: What if I don't pluck it?

faq.q: Are there instruments that do both shaking and blowing?
faq.a: Some instruments might have parts that you shake while you blow into them. It depends on the design.
asks: Can I blow and shake at the same time?

faq.q: How do I make a sound with my mouth?
faq.a: You can make sounds like whistling or humming. These use your breath just like blowing into a flute.
asks: Can I use my voice like an instrument?

facts: Drums are often hit with sticks or hands.
Plucking strings is done with fingers or plectrums.
Instruments like flutes require blowing air.
Shakers use beads or small objects to create sound.

quiz.say: A person playing a trumpet is using which action to make sound?
quiz.why: The trumpet needs air from your breath to make the sound come out.

wrong.0: Hitting is for things like drums, not usually trumpets.
wrong.1: Shaking is for instruments that rattle, like a maraca.
wrong.3: Plucking is used for instruments with strings, like a guitar.

quiz.say: If you are playing a maraca, what action are you using?
quiz.why: Maracas make sound when you move them back and forth quickly.

wrong.0: Plucking needs something to pull the string, like a finger.
wrong.1: Hitting needs something solid to strike, like a drum.
wrong.3: Blowing needs an air source, like into a flute.

quiz.say: A banjo makes sound because you:
quiz.why: Banjo strings are made to vibrate when you pluck them with your fingers.

wrong.0: Hitting is for drums, not typically the banjo.
wrong.1: Shaking is for instruments with beads inside.
wrong.3: Blowing is for instruments like the whistle or flute.
